description: The Nouadhibou Regional Hospital worker strike began March 1 and included daily protests and a March 25 sit-in, but attendance at any gathering is not reported. A search-only February 20 report of “dozens” is out of month and cannot be assigned to the March action.
required_followup: Seek March-specific count and establish whether the daily protests/strike/sit-in form one action; keep unknown end pending.

description: February COVID-worker action and March 30 action involve broadly the same worker group and issue, but the sources do not say they are one continuous campaign. March’s event was at a different government site.

description: Search results report Nouadhibou hospital workers ending their strike after a meeting with the regional governor on April 4, but the result is search-only and the body was not opened. description: Cridem search results show additional Nouadhibou hospital reports and student protests, but exact publication dates and story origins are not established. They are not treated as independent corroboration.

description: Three identical Q019 search calls were executed, but their full tool outputs were not durably saved: one output was truncated in the tool handoff, and two subsequent attempts to save the output failed because btoa/TextEncoder were unavailable. Search-log rows preserve the exact known prompt and mark result headers unavailable; empty returned_urls must not be read as zero results. No evidence claim is based on these calls; do not retry.
required_followup: Do not repeat the query or reconstruct results. Use only durable Q001–Q018 and Q020 captures; if a future scope reopens research, choose distinct queries.

description: Searches sampled French, Arabic and English for monthly protests, workers, education, women’s events, COVID workers, Nouadhibou, Nouakchott, Zouerate, Rosso, Kaédi and Kiffa, including AMI, Al Akhbar, Cridem and local/international sources. Coverage remains partial: several results were unrelated/out-of-month; no site-specific turnout emerged; regional and sector coverage is not exhaustive. Searches do not establish that other events did not occur. The open web cannot replicate LexisNexis.
required_followup: At any future extension, target additional independent regional press/union records with week- and sector-specific queries; do not repeat these exact prompts.
